mapper.select: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN i.RULE_DECISION IN ('INCLUDED','DEFAULT_INCLUDED') AND f.QUALITY_CODE='READY' THEN i.USAGE_VALUE END) USAGE_VALUE, COUNT(DISTINCT i.METER_ID) PROJECTED_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN i.RULE_DECISION IN ('INCLUDED','DEFAULT_INCLUDED') AND f.QUALITY_CODE='READY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) INCLUDED_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN i.RULE_DECISION='EXCLUDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) EXCLUDED_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN i.RULE_DECISION='INVALID' OR (i.RULE_DECISION IN ('INCLUDED','DEFAULT_INCLUDED') AND f.QUALITY_CODE NOT IN ('READY','MISSING_BOUNDARY')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) INVALID_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN i.RULE_DECISION IN ('INCLUDED','DEFAULT_INCLUDED') AND f.QUALITY_CODE='MISSING_BOUNDARY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) MISSING_COUNT FROM SMT_ENERGY_PARK_DAY_ITEM i JOIN SMT_ENERGY_METER_DAY_FACT f ON f.ID=i.METER_DAY_FACT_ID WHERE i.PARK_ID=#{parkId} AND i.STAT_DATE=#{statDate} AND i.RESOURCE_TYPE=#{resourceType} AND i.UNIT=#{unit}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO SMT_ENERGY_PARK_DAY t USING(SELECT #{id} id,#{parkId} park_id,#{statDate} stat_date,#{resourceType} resource_type,#{unit} unit,#{usageValue} usage_value,#{meterCount} meter_count,#{qualitySummary} quality_summary,#{calculatedAt} calculated_at FROM dual)s ON(t.PARK_ID=s.park_id AND t.STAT_DATE=s.stat_date AND t.RESOURCE_TYPE=s.resource_type AND t.UNIT=s.unit) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET USAGE_VALUE=s.usage_value,METER_COUNT=s.meter_count,QUALITY_SUMMARY=s.quality_summary,CALCULATED_AT=s.calculated_at WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT(ID,PARK_ID,STAT_DATE,RESOURCE_TYPE,UNIT,USAGE_VALUE,METER_COUNT,QUALITY_SUMMARY,CALCULATED_AT) VALUES(s.id,s.park_id,s.stat_date,s.resource_type,s.unit,s.usage_value,s.meter_count,s.quality_summary,s.calculated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT ID,PARK_ID,STAT_DATE,RESOURCE_TYPE,UNIT,USAGE_VALUE,METER_COUNT,QUALITY_SUMMARY,CALCULATED_AT FROM SMT_ENERGY_PARK_DAY WHERE PARK_ID=#{parkId} AND STAT_DATE >= #{monthStart} AND STAT_DATE <= #{today} ORDER BY STAT_DATE
